access: Choose your park entrance before navigating: Yosemite has no single arrival address. Higher roads close seasonally. Plan valley parking and shuttle stops together, with a separate plan for areas beyond the valley.

access: For Zion Canyon, plan around Springdale's South Entrance and visitor-center shuttle stop. Parking can fill; check Springdale park-and-ride options. Kolob Canyons is a separate access area.
เที่ยว Zion Canyon ให้ยึดทางเข้า South Entrance ที่ Springdale และป้ายรถรับส่งศูนย์บริการ ที่จอดอาจเต็มจึงควรดูทางเลือกจอดแล้วต่อรถในเมือง ส่วน Kolob Canyons ใช้ทางเข้าแยก

photos.author: w_lemay
photos.caption: Built between 2003 and 2006, this contemporary theater was designed by Ateliers Jean Nouvel and Architectural Alliance, and features a distinctive dark blue paneled facade. The ten-story building stands 167 feet tall, with three theater performance spaces inside, LED masts that can light up and display messages or visuals, and a 178-foot long, cantilevered “Endless Bridge” that extends towards the Mississippi River from the fourth floor over West River Parkway. Inspired by the form of nearby former mill buildings, the structure features heavy use of geometric forms on the exterior, long strips of windows, and a large, cantilevered yellow glass-enclosed exterior of the Amber Box lobby on the ninth floor. The building is a unique and distinctive feature of the city, and the first commission for Ateliers Jean Nouvel in the United States.

The Vegas Strip is reputed to be the brightest spot on Earth due to the concentration of lights on its hotels and casinos. The tarmac of McCarran International Airport is dark by comparison, while the airstrips of Nellis Air Force Base on the north-eastern fringe are likewise dark. The dark mass of Frenchman Mountain borders the city to the east.

IAIA operates the Museum of Contemporary Native Arts, which is housed in the historic Santa Fe Federal Building (the old Post Office), a landmark Pueblo Revival building listed on the National Register of Historic Places. photos.author: aparlette
photos.caption: The impressive size of Ash Cave makes it one of the gems of Hocking Hills State Park in Ohio. The magnitude of the rock formation is spectacular to behold, and highlighted in a photo by the small size of people seen on the floor of the cave. Ash Cave is in the southern area of Hocking Hills after a short quarter mile hike. The cave makes a horseshoe shape and goes about 700 feet from end to end and a rim that is 90 feet high. There is a waterfall from the rim to the floor, but on this day it was a thin stream of water hitting the pool below.
